title: Tunisian Masarepa Fritters
description: A crispy and flavorful snack inspired by Tunisian cuisine, made with crispy fried fritters and masarepa cornmeal.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine masarepa, water, salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Mix well to form a dough.
2. Add the chopped fritters to the dough and mix until well combined.
3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
4. Using a spoon, drop small portions of the dough mixture into the hot oil.
5. Flatten the dough portions slightly with a spatula and fry for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
6. Remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
7. Serve the fritters hot and enjoy!
